zh_CN: 造成 6 点伤害。获得 [url=kw:exhaust]消耗[/url]。

zh_CN: 自身打出卡牌时不受[url=kw:hand_slot_damage]手牌槽伤害[/url]效果影响。

该槽位每打出一张牌，对随机 1 名敌人造成 12+100% 物理攻击的蓝属性伤害，持续 3 回合。

zh_CN: 不会行动的训练木桩，用来观察输出与机制。

zh_CN: 每回合开始时恢复 10000 点生命。

Take the coins from the offerings.

zh_CN: 恢复队伍共享生命，使用次数可叠加。

zh_CN: 战斗开始时，自身2号手牌槽永久充能II：队伍恢复15+100%恢复量点生命，己方全体2回合【物攻·魔攻+12】。
en: At battle start, grant permanent Charge II to own slot 2: heal the team for 15 + 100% Heal Power and grant all allies +12 Physical and Magic Attack for 2 turns.
+12 Physical and Magic Attack for 2 turns.

zh_CN: 永久充能II：队伍恢复15+100%恢复量点生命，己方全体2回合物攻·魔攻+12。
en: Permanent Charge II: heal the team for 15 + 100% Heal Power and grant all allies +12 Physical and Magic Attack for 2 turns.
Charge I for 1 turns: heal the team for 100.
Charge I for 3 turns: heal the team for 75.
Charge I for 5 turns: heal the team for 50.

zh_CN: 自身1号手牌槽1回合充能I【队伍恢复100点生命】，3号手牌槽3回合充能I【队伍恢复75点生命】，5号手牌槽5回合充能I【队伍恢复50点生命】。
en: Grant Charge I to own slots 1, 3 and 5 for 1, 3 and 5 turns, healing the team for 100, 75 and 50 respectively.

zh_CN: 队伍恢复40+100%恢复量点生命。
en: Heal the team for 40 + 100% Heal Power.

zh_CN: 己方全体获得20点护盾，队伍恢复25+100%恢复量点生命。
en: Grant all allies 20 shield and heal the team for 25 + 100% Heal Power.

zh_CN: 自身下回合抽卡+2，本回合获得1点临时能量。
en: Gain +2 card draws next turn and 1 temporary energy this turn.

zh_CN: 自身2回合【恢复量+4】，技能进度+2。
en: Gain +4 Heal Power for 2 turns and 2 skill progress.

zh_CN: 敌方入场时，使其永久物攻·魔攻-12，不可驱散。
en: Whenever an enemy enters, permanently reduce its Physical and Magic Attack by 12. Cannot be dispelled.

zh_CN: 永久物攻·魔攻-12，不可驱散。
en: Permanently -12 Physical and Magic Attack. Cannot be dispelled.

zh_CN: 阶层开始时或阶层内每6回合开始时：自身技能进度+1，蓝元素角色+1，机械角色+1，人类角色+1；各条件独立叠加。
en: At floor start and every 6 floor turns: self, Blue, Machine and Human characters each gain 1 skill progress. Matching categories stack.

zh_CN: 自身释放主动技能后，展开1回合领域【虚幻世界】：双方满足蓝元素、机械、人类任一条件的角色受到伤害-50%；敌方全体1回合物防·魔防变为0。
en: After casting the active skill, open Illusory World for 1 turn: Blue, Machine or Human combatants on either side take 50% less damage. All enemies have 0 Physical and Magic Defense for 1 turn.

zh_CN: 领域内，蓝元素、机械、人类任一条件的角色受到伤害-50%，多条件命中只生效一次。
en: While the domain is active, Blue, Machine or Human combatants take 50% less damage, once per combatant.
Set Physical and Magic Defense to 0 for 1 turn.
-30 Physical Attack, Magic Attack, Physical Defense and Magic Defense for 1 turn.

zh_CN: 敌方全体1回合【物攻·魔攻·物防·魔防-30】。
en: All enemies lose 30 Physical Attack, Magic Attack, Physical Defense and Magic Defense for 1 turn.
-8 Physical and Magic Attack for 2 turns.
-12 Physical and Magic Defense for 2 turns.

zh_CN: 敌方全体2回合【物攻·魔攻-8】。
en: All enemies lose 8 Physical and Magic Attack for 2 turns.

zh_CN: 敌方全体受到12+50%魔攻的蓝元素魔法伤害，随后2回合【魔防-6】。
en: Deal 12 + 50% Magic Attack as Blue magic damage to all enemies, then reduce their Magic Defense by 6 for 2 turns.

zh_CN: 己方全体获得25点护盾，自身技能进度+1。
en: Grant all allies 25 shield and gain 1 skill progress.

zh_CN: 使目标敌人的行动计数变为2，2回合【物防·魔防-12】。
en: Set one enemy's action count to 2 and reduce its Physical and Magic Defense by 12 for 2 turns.

zh_CN: 3回合负面效果。结束或被驱散时：对敌方全体造成12＋100%魔法攻击的红元素魔法伤害，然后重新添加自身。每层独立计算。
en: After 3 turns or when dispelled, deal 12 + 100% Magic Attack as red magical damage to all enemies, then reapply this instance. Each instance resolves independently.

zh_CN: 免疫手牌槽伤害效果。战斗开始时自身获得1层3回合乌翎。
en: Immune to hand-slot damage effects. At battle start, gain one 3-turn Crow Feather.

zh_CN: 战斗开始时：自身1号手牌槽永久充能II，触发时驱散自身所有可驱散负面效果。
en: At battle start, slot 1 gains permanent Charge II: dispel all dispellable debuffs on self.

zh_CN: 每在此槽打出2张卡：驱散自身所有可驱散负面效果，然后重置计数。
en: After every 2 cards played from this slot, dispel all dispellable debuffs on self and reset the counter.

zh_CN: 阶层开始时或阶层内每9回合开始时：自身技能进度＋2，红元素角色＋1，机械角色＋1，动物角色＋1。分别计算，可叠加。
en: At floor start and every 9 floor turns: self gains 2 skill progress; red, Machine, and Animal characters each gain 1 independently.

zh_CN: 战斗开始时：自身额外获得1层乌翎。
en: At battle start, gain one additional Crow Feather.
Self gains 12 Magic Attack for 3 turns.
Self gains 8 Magic Attack for 2 turns.

zh_CN: 自身3回合魔法攻击＋12，然后驱散自身所有可驱散负面效果（不含手牌槽）。
en: Gain 12 Magic Attack for 3 turns, then dispel all dispellable debuffs on self (excluding hand slots).

zh_CN: 驱散自身所有可驱散负面效果，自身技能进度＋1。
en: Dispel all dispellable debuffs on self and gain 1 skill progress.

zh_CN: 对敌方单体造成20＋100%魔法攻击的红元素魔法伤害。
en: Deal 20 + 100% Magic Attack as red magical damage to one enemy.

zh_CN: 自身2回合魔法攻击＋8，并获得20点护盾。
en: Gain 8 Magic Attack for 2 turns and 20 shield.

zh_CN: 对敌方全体造成12＋50%魔法攻击的红元素魔法伤害，然后驱散自身所有可驱散负面效果。
en: Deal 12 + 50% Magic Attack as red magical damage to all enemies, then dispel all dispellable debuffs on self.
